description: Source code for nsRemoteDebuggingPipe class implementing inter-thread communication and remote debugging pipe functionality in Mozilla Firefox.

classes.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe
classes.description: Implements a remote debugging communication pipe with threading and platform-specific I/O handling.

methods.name: ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the pipe, optionally requiring exact size.

methods.name: WriteBytes
methods.description: Writes a buffer of bytes to the pipe, handling partial writes.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::GetSingleton
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the pipe.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::Init
methods.description: Initializes the pipe with a client, sets up threads, and platform-specific handles.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::Stop
methods.description: Stops the pipe, shuts down threads, and releases resources.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::ReaderLoop
methods.description: Main loop for reading data from the pipe, dispatching messages to the main thread.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages received from the pipe.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message through the pipe, dispatching work to the writer thread.
